PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

JWT_SECRET.description: Generated jwt secret. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Public url resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

PASSWORD_SALT.description: Generated password salt. Keep private and preserve with backups.

POSTGRESQL_HOST.description: Postgresql host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

POSTGRESQL_PORT.description: Postgresql port for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

POSTGRESQL_USER.description: Postgresql user for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

POSTGRESQL_DBNAME.description: Postgresql dbname for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

POSTGRESQL_PASSWORD.description: Postgresql password resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

PGDATA.description: PostgreSQL data directory within the persistent volume. Do not change on an existing database.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Initial PostgreSQL database name, or the matching database selected by the application.

POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL initialization user, or the matching connection user for the private database.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password. Generated for the database and referenced by dependent services; keep private.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for bewcloud. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Require owner authentication for every application route.
